newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's Pennu sees increased 1997 profit.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's Pennu sees increased 1997 profit.

text.p: Estonian computer firm Pennu on Tuesday forecast a 1997 net profit of between nine and 10 million kroons after a profit last year of 4.5 million kroons.
It said in a statement that its planned 1997 turnover for Estonia was 200-230 million kroons and outside Estonia it was planned at 50 to 70 million kroons.
Pennu is quoted on the Tallinn stock exchange.

The firm also said its first-half 1997 forecast turnover was 80 million kroons in Estonia and 20 million kroons outside Estonia. This would lead to a net first-half profit of 3.5 million kroons, the company added.
